description: 국가철도공단 수도권7호선 화장실 [railways and stations] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 서울교통공사에서 운영하는 7호선의 역사별 화장실에 대한 데이터로, 철도운영기관명, 선명, 역명, 화장실의 역층, 게이트내외, 출구번호, 상세위치 데이터가 있습니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 9 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 도시광역철도, 7호선, 화장실수, 남녀구분, 장애구분. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
